reviewer: Independent Codex subagent /root/v19_astra_review; explicitly requested Astra at Max
scope: Exact four source-native sheets only: Union A S direction 2 and Confederate A N direction 6 contact/casualty, 16 row-major cells. Installation/runtime/browser acceptance is separate.
decision: The corrected exact sources are suitable for a bounded opt-in art pilot with fresh per-army shared registration; no blocking source defect remains.

sourceWideReferenceMethod.method: Independently choose visible cap-only crown ROIs and nearer supporting-sole ROIs for all four contact cells of each army. Recompute alpha>=64 extrema in native coordinates, subtract capTop from sole maxYExclusive, and take exact half-up median. Apply that one value to all eight contact/casualty cells for that army.
sourceWideReferenceMethod.confederateCapROIInterpretation: First guard crown ROI lies to the right of the rifle; forward-extension crown ROI lies to the right of the adjacent hand. These visible-cap patches exclude weapon/skin when measuring the cap support span.
sourceWideReferenceMethod.coordinates: Native cell-local integer pixels. ROIs are [x0,y0,x1,y1] with exclusive right/bottom. Ground Y is maxYExclusive of alpha>=64 support pixels inside the visually selected ROI.

rootMethod: Select projected pelvis X for upright/braced contact and early stumble; use the relevant projected pelvis/lower torso/knee/torso for later casualty phases. Select ground Y from an actual visible sole, knee, lower body cloth edge or supporting forearm, not full sprite/weapon bounds. X is independent of the Y ROI and may lie outside it. These are model-interpreted presentation supports, not physical-anatomy certification.
scaleJudgment: Head, torso/gear and limb sizes remain coherent within each pair and compatible with the inspected v7 kit/v20-v21 illustration style. The final Confederate contact source occupies less projected native height than rejected attempts; direct head/kit/limb comparison with its casualty partner did not establish a scale blocker. Bracing, knee bends and prone projections remain naturally unequal in height. Actual rendered contact-to-loss transitions are still required.
northThrustResolution: The initially reviewed Confederate upper-right pose aimed mostly screen-left from shoulder height; its first replacement remained a diagonal guard. Both were rejected. The final hash projects the bayonet north beside the cap, extends the forward hand ahead of the head, and keeps stock/rear grip at the hip. That is a plausible short forward extension for this bounded source pilot; a single still can also read as raised forward guard, so convincing thrust timing/weight transfer is not certified.

limitations: Very low-alpha colored noise remains, including at some native cell edges; solid margins do not certify fringe freedom. Inspect on actual terrain.
Rear-facing grips are partly occluded. Forward-extension versus raised-guard reading and believable thrust/weight transfer require actual playback; no drill or anatomical certification.
Only primary Union S and Confederate N contact/casualty are added. Reverse bearings, diagonals, Union B and other roles remain incomplete.
Common contact-derived scale preserves natural projected posture changes; do not repair animation by individual phase resizing. Confirm scale and support continuity in actual Scene and browser play.
Model source inspection is not outside human usability validation, GPU validation, default promotion, production release or a whole-game quality grade.

Actual opposing N/S contact and losses with all casualty phases, plus preserved E/W.
Source-native exports byte-identical; frozen bindings and independent final review.
Pause, first cold draw/resave, reduced motion and resolution semantics; inherited legacy edge separately documented.
Actual terrain readability at normal/close/overview and narrow layout.
